div.div:
Ack SQS only from ready · failed · blocked · unknown.
A crash before ack → redelivery → claim sees terminal → ack without work.
Unknown is resolved only by ops recover-job (never auto-retried).

Circuit breaker (process-local): 5 consecutive known failures → open 60 s → one half-open probe. Blocks admission, so no paid call is reserved.
Reuse: a completed stage is reused after a crash only if request, scope, and evidence hashes still match.
